title: Thank you Team Claude Code!
body:
Not really sure where to put this.  This seems like as good a place as any

I'd just like to say thank you to everyone involved with this project.  Claude Code is a dream come true for me.  I have been coding for 30 years and for a lot of what I want to do today, I can actually use natural language instructions and have Claude Code achieve it for me.  I have a few candles on my birthday cakes.. I wasn't sure if I would ever see the day, but after using Claude Code for the last 3 weeks it's clear that the day has already come and gone.  What an amazing tool you have created for us all.  I can't wait to see how it evolves over time. 

One request... can you please do some shirts, coffee mugs or something with Claude Code on it.  I will buy it.
author: tlc-ben-quinn
